youtube.title: OpenIDEA: An IntelliJ-Style IDE Rebuilt in Rust
youtube.description:
OpenIDEA brings the IntelliJ IDEA keymap, tool windows and search-everything habits to a native app with a Rust core. It covers editor, debugger, Git, terminal, database and HTTP clients for 60+ languages. The benchmark in the README is the maker's own, on one project.
Repo: https://github.com/l0ng-ai/openidea
